title: Restore the C1 order of RATING_SCALE (BBB- before BB+) in src/ratings/notch.mjs and pin it with a literal regression test
context: Why: merge commit 84e2366 ('refactor: tidy the rating scale') went onto the job branch outside dl. It swapped BBB- and BB+ in RATING_SCALE in src/ratings/notch.mjs, so the scale now reads ...BBB+, BBB, BB+, BBB-, BB... C1 and plan AC-1 require ...BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-... Every notch count across the BBB-/BB+ boundary is wrong (notchChange('BBB+','BB+') must be 3; notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB-') must be {notches:2,direction:'downgrade',wl:1}). T-01's contract tests (test/integration/ratings/notch.contract.test.mjs) fail (26 failures in the full node --test run). Fix: restore the order and change nothing else. Do not touch notchChange, notchCalculator, validation, error messages or exports. REQUIRED CONTRACT: RATING_SCALE stays a named export built with Object.freeze([...]) and deep-equals exactly, best first: ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]. Indices: AAA 0 ... BBB- 9, BB+ 10 ... CCC- 18. Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true. Regression test: in test/ratings/notch.test.mjs add or keep a test comparing RATING_SCALE with assert.deepStrictEqual against that array written out literally in the test (not derived from the module, sorted or built in a loop). Check that the existing unit tests in test/ratings/notch.test.mjs were not changed to match the swapped order; if they were, restore the C1 values (notchChange('BBB+','BB+')=3, ('BBB+','BBB-')=2, ('AAA','CCC-')=18). Do not edit T-01's QA file test/integration/ratings/notch.contract.test.mjs; it must pass unchanged. T-02 (src/indicators/countryRating.mjs) imports notchChange; its files are outside this card's scope. Node 18+ ESM, node:test + node:assert/strict, no npm dependencies, no I/O in src/ratings. Commit as '<CARD-ID>: restore C1 rating scale order'.
acceptance: AC-1: RATING_SCALE imported from src/ratings/notch.mjs deep-equals the literal array ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"], has length 19, and Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) is true.
AC-1: notchChange('BBB+','BB+') === 3, notchChange('BB+','BBB+') === -3, notchChange('BBB','BBB-') === 1, notchChange('BBB-','BB+') === 1, notchChange('AAA','CCC-') === 18.
AC-2: notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB-') deep-equals {notches:2,direction:'downgrade',wl:1} and notchCalculator('BBB+','BB+') deep-equals {notches:3,direction:'downgrade',wl:2}.
AC-3: test/ratings/notch.test.mjs has a regression test comparing RATING_SCALE by assert.deepStrictEqual against the 19 ratings written literally in the test.
AC-1: T-01's test/integration/ratings/notch.contract.test.mjs passes unchanged, and the diff touches only src/ratings/notch.mjs (the scale literal) and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs.
